title: XO Appliances — Brand Guide
intro: Brand overview, customer profile, and selling angles for XO Appliances.

sections.title: Brand Story
sections.content: Tagline: "Kitchen Ventilation." Specialty tier. XO Appliances makes range hoods, ventilation components, and small kitchen appliances. Mid-range ventilation options with good feature sets at competitive pricing.

sections.title: The Right Customer
sections.content: Mid-range ventilation needs. Value-conscious hood buyers.

sections.title: Selling Angles
sections.content:
Key selling angles for XO Appliances:

• Mid-range ventilation at competitive pricing

• Good feature-to-price ratio

• Multiple hood styles and configurations

• Growing dealer availability

• Solid quality without premium pricing
